Class ShamanRitualEffectData

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.effects.ShamanRitualEffectData
public class ShamanRitualEffectData extends Object
Mutable accumulator collecting the bonuses contributed by building effects during the resolution of a Shaman Ritual event. Tracks bonus stars and the loss/win modifiers.
